content: Aakalibili banga-a-kana mweẽ ti bo bafaana okakihi litumu li bamfumu ba nsie ya lili ba baakatumu, bakakala a bintamana ya bakakala baba mukughu mu bigyighili byehene bi bibwe.
Bo banyaã okakuhu baara, bakala banga-a-edzuunu, ba baakatwu eyiẽ ŋa kara li baara, ya bo bakasuo nzya-nzyara yi edzuunu matala mwohono kundaa baara bwohono.

Mu kuulu, mu matala ma makulu bihi-a-be si líili baara ba bagwene a mayele, baara baala ka bákakihi litumu li Nzaami o, ba bádzimini nzili, bankana ba nzala ya bisee bibi mawa-mawa. Bumweẽ bu bihi búli kunsa bubi ya bihi líilwulu mu nsu-nsughu a mukolo, baara bákabele bihi ya bihi a bihi líikabele babake.

content.text: Lo mu matala ma oomoŋono mu baara,
bubwe bu Nzaami Mubvwuhu a bihi-a-be,
–Ka mu kuulu ti bihi liisi bigyighili bibi bunsumu o,
lo mu nkooro a nyiĩ yi aakamono nde bihi–
nde aabvwuhu bihi bu asuagha bihi mu liboghoro lili mbu-mburu yi nyaghara
ya yi a Mufulu a Ngili.
Mufulu a Ngili wu, Nzaami aagyirili bihi nde ku olagha
mu nzili a Yiisu-Kriste mubvwuhu a bihi,
mpaala, mu bwehe bu nde Nzaami asa bihi baba nsumu,
ya ba baagwolo pfa ti bwunu a bu oli emiini kii laama lili mibvu ya mibvu.

content: Ndagha yi yili yi a ngaŋma, ya me ndzyi ti we sa epini mu okaluo yo mpaala ba baasi kana li bo mu Nzaami, basa mukolo a bo mu okala a bigyighili bi bibvulu bubwe. Obo oli bubwe ya mubwughu kundaa baara bwohono.

Lo we faana obihi munsohobo mu mandagha ma magwene a mupfunu, mu mi mitala mankwumu ma bankagha-kwuru, mu mimbaŋana, mu munsohobo mu mikyene. Mu kuulu mandagha mwohono mamo mali mama bwunu ya ma magwene a mupfunu.
Mbwuru wu aakasa munkabala, we faana ogyehe nde sa lili nsomo ya lili gyolo, ya ŋa nseele, kala ti nde ka gyughu o, paha nde mu libwunu.
We soolo ti mbwuru wu obo aadzimini nzili ya li mu okasa masumu. Nde li mu okagwa nyuru a ndeme ebili.
Mu matala ma akala aangweghe me we Aratemase bwunu we Tisyike, we faana ogya ku ndi me ku bvulu lili Nikopolise. Mu kuulu me aangwolo munkaana wu oluhu ndo yi a mpie yi alagha oko.
We faana ogyighili obaha Dzenase wu gyighili osoolo mikyene ya Apolose mu bilogho bi bali a bo nzala a bye mu midzye, mpaala banyaã ogwene a elogho.
Baara ba bihi-a-be si bafaana okagyighi bigyighili bibi nkara a bubwe, mpaala baleene okabaha ba baakakala a nzala a libaha mu bilogho bibi mupfunu, mu kuulu banyaã okala ba bagwene a bimburu.
Baara bwohono ba bali ya me bagwi we mamboro. Gwa mamboro kundaa babo ba bali bandughu ba bihi mu kana.

content.text: Nyaã bwehe bu Nzaami bukala ya be bwohono!
